long_biography.plain_text:
Lost Boys placed Jan Pieter Melchior among the Dutch producers who carried interactive media from compact discs into the early web. He appeared on television as a CD-i producer in 1994, when the young studio was developing interactive discs. The business later repositioned itself around creative internet services and expanded its reach across Europe.

Dragons' Den made Melchior a public investor on its first Dutch season. Contestants presented fledgling companies to five business figures who could commit their own capital. He appeared throughout the 2007 series, evaluating business plans in nine televised episodes.
